vacation.usage: 辨析:leave指士兵/政府人员休假;vacation指学校寒暑假;day-off指公休日；n.假期，休庭期；休假，假期 v.度假；发音类似我开心→为什么开心？因为有一个很长的假期→假期

ex.en: If it's their vacation home anyway, and it's just empty, why can't you make money off it?
ex.zh: 如果这是他们的度假屋，而且正好闲置，为什么不能靠它赚钱呢？

ex.en: They rented a cottage by the lake for their summer vacation.
ex.zh: 他们在湖边租了一栋小屋度暑假。

ex.en: Factory workers there are entitled to a paid vacation of several weeks each year.
ex.zh: 那里的工厂工人每年享有数周的带薪假期。

ex.en: Scientists are testing a new vaccine that could protect against several strains of influenza at once.
ex.zh: 科学家正在试验一种能同时预防多种流感毒株的新疫苗。

ex.en: Health officials launched a nationwide vaccination campaign after measles cases doubled.
ex.zh: 麻疹病例翻番后，卫生官员发起了一场全国性疫苗接种运动。

ex.en: Scientists are testing a new vaccine against the flu virus.
ex.zh: 科学家正在试验一种新的流感疫苗。

ex.en: The vaccine must be kept at a low temperature during transport.
ex.zh: 疫苗在运输过程中必须保持低温。

ex.en: Health officials hope the vaccine will be available to the public within a year.
ex.zh: 卫生官员希望这种疫苗一年之内能向公众提供。

senses: vt. 用真空吸尘器打扫
vacuum.usage: n.真空；真空吸尘器；空白，空虚 v.用真空吸尘器打扫；索引p419

ex.en: Sound cannot travel through a vacuum.
ex.zh: 声音无法在真空中传播。

ex.en: The sudden resignation of the minister left a vacuum in the department's leadership.
ex.zh: 部长的突然辞职使该部门的领导层出现真空。

ex.en: She vacuumed the carpet before the guests arrived.
ex.zh: 客人到来之前，她用吸尘器清扫了地毯。

senses: adj. 含糊的，不明确的，模糊的
adj. 模糊的，不清楚的，不明确的
vague.usage: adj.不明确的；模糊的 /əˌkjuː mjə'leɪʃn/ 3 n.积累，堆积；堆积物，堆积 量；发音类似"喂哥"→打电话一直喊喂哥听不清→模糊的，不清楚的；索引p419

ex.en: Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses, he came right out and said he was leaving "to pursue my goal of running a company".
ex.zh: 他没有用常见的一些含糊不清的借口掩盖自己的离职，而是公开声明，他离职是"为了追求我经营一家公司的目标"。

ex.en: a vague agreement // vague excuses // vague pronouncements
ex.zh: 含糊的协定 // 含糊的借口 // 含糊的声明

ex.en: His vague answer failed to satisfy the reporters who wanted a clear commitment.
ex.zh: 他含糊其辞的回答未能让想要明确承诺的记者们满意。

ex.en: She has only a vague memory of the accident because she struck her head.
ex.zh: 她对事故只有模糊的记忆，因为她撞到了头部。

senses: adj. 徒劳的，无结果的；自负的
vain.usage: 发音类似"问"→你问也白问，没有答案，一切都是"徒劳的"→徒劳的

ex.en: The point of a style upgrade isn't to become more vain or to spend more time fussing over what to wear.
ex.zh: 形象提升的关键并不是变得更加虚荣，或是花费更多的时间纠结该穿什么。

ex.en: I knocked loudly in the vain hope that someone might answer.
ex.zh: 我敲门敲得很响，希望有人应声，却是徒然。

ex.en: Scientists made a vain attempt to save the endangered species from extinction.
ex.zh: 科学家们为拯救濒危物种免于灭绝作了徒劳的努力。

ex.en: All their efforts to persuade the board proved vain, as the merger had already been decided.
ex.zh: 他们说服董事会的所有努力都被证明是徒劳的，因为合并已成定局。

ex.en: Researchers evaluated the programme over five years before recommending its national rollout.
ex.zh: 研究人员在建议全国推广之前对该项目进行了为期五年的评估。

senses: adj. ①合理的，有效的，有根据的
adj. （法律上）有效的，有法律效力的；合理的
valid.usage: 发音类似“歪理的”→这不是歪理的，是“合理的；有法律效力的”。；索引p419

ex.en: Certainly, there are valid concerns about the patchwork regulations that could result if every state sets its own rules.
ex.zh: 诚然，如果每个州都设立自己的法令可能导致立法的混乱，这种担忧是不无道理的。

ex.en: People can contribute experience or information to your thinking—all the things that would make the disagreement stronger or more valid.
ex.zh: 他们可以为你的想法贡献经验或信息——所有这些都会让你的异议更有说服力或更合理。

ex.en: Your season ticket remains valid until the end of March.
ex.zh: 你的季票三月月底前仍然有效。

ex.en: The committee rejected the proposal because it lacked valid supporting evidence.
ex.zh: 委员会驳回了该提案，因为它缺乏有效的支持证据。

senses: vt. 证实，验证；使生效，批准
validate.usage: invalidate 的反义词；validate 使有效/确认有效；valid adj. 有效的。

ex.en: Further research is needed to validate these results.
ex.zh: 需要进一步研究来验证这些结果。

ex.en: Peer review is designed to validate the methods and conclusions of published research.
ex.zh: 同行评审旨在验证已发表研究的方法和结论。

ex.en: The company conducted field tests to validate the safety of its new vehicle model.
ex.zh: 公司进行了实地测试，以验证其新车型号的安全性。

ex.en: Independent experts were invited to validate the accuracy of the survey data.
ex.zh: 独立专家受邀核实调查数据的准确性。

senses: n. 符合逻辑；合法性；(正式的)认可

ex.en: You make further inferences, for instance, about how the text may be significant to you, or about its validity.
ex.zh: 比如，你进一步推断这篇文章对你来说重要的原因，或者说它的合理性。

phrases.p: a small town set in a valley

valley.usage: 记：他在靠近山谷的小镇上看到了一记漂亮的凌空击球。

ex.en: The villages scattered along the valley depend heavily on tourism for their annual income.
ex.zh: 散布在山谷沿线的村庄的年收入在很大程度上依赖旅游业。

ex.en: Internships offer students valuable experience that cannot be learned from textbooks alone.
ex.zh: 实习为学生提供仅靠课本无法学到的宝贵经验。

ex.en: The museum keeps its most valuable paintings in rooms with strictly controlled temperature.
ex.zh: 博物馆将其最珍贵的画作保存在温度受到严格控制的展厅里。

ex.en: Volunteers' time is a valuable resource that many charities could not operate without.
ex.zh: 志愿者的时间是许多慈善机构不可或缺的宝贵资源。

senses: ③重要性，益处；④(pl.)价值观，标准
vt. ①估价，评价；②尊重，重视

ex.en: In fact, rushing to get your own ideas out there can cause colleagues to feel you don't value their opinions.
ex.zh: 事实上，急于把自己的想法说出来会让同事觉得你不重视他们的意见。

ex.en: The value of the old painting has tripled since it was bought.
ex.zh: 这幅古画的价值自购入以来已翻了三倍。

ex.en: Parents should help children develop sound moral values.
ex.zh: 父母应当帮助孩子树立正确的价值观。

senses: n. 阀;(英)电子管,真空管(c);心脏瓣膜

ex.en: Engineers replaced a faulty valve in the pipeline before it could cause a serious leak.
ex.zh: 工程师在管道上一个出故障的阀门造成严重泄漏之前将其更换。

senses: n. 有篷货车,(铁路的)行李车(c)
[军]先头部队(或舰队);[喻]前驱,先锋,领导者

ex.en: A delivery van broke down outside the factory, delaying the shipment of several urgent orders.
ex.zh: 一辆送货车在工厂外抛锚，延误了数笔紧急订单的发货。

ex.en: The railway company has installed cameras to deter vandalism on late-night trains.
ex.zh: 铁路公司安装了摄像头，以威慑深夜列车上的故意破坏行为。

senses: vi. 突然消失，逐渐消散
vanish.usage: van（空）+ish→变空→消失。近义：disappear vi. 消失；[近]disappear vi. 消失；辨析:vanish突然不见、消失;disappear指从视线中消失;fade指消退、逐步消失、褪去；v.突然消失；灭绝；消亡 很多wealthy 家庭可以承受高昂的tuition，以享受standardiz

ex.en: Yet pleasure at your own can vanish if you learn that a colleague has been given a bigger one.
ex.zh: 但（涨薪后）假如你得知你的同事涨得比你还多，你加薪带来的快乐就会突然消失。

ex.en: Many rare species will vanish forever if their habitats keep shrinking.
ex.zh: 如果栖息地持续缩小，许多珍稀物种将永远消失。

ex.en: The thief vanished into the crowd before the police arrived.
ex.zh: 警察赶到之前，小偷已在人群中消失得无影无踪。

vanity.usage: van(empty空)+ity(名词后缀)→空虚→虚荣心；索引p419

ex.en: Vanity is a constant; people will only start shopping more sustainably when they can't afford not to.
ex.zh: 虚荣心一直存在；人们只有在不得不的情况下才会开始更可持续地购物。

ex.en: His vanity prevented him from admitting that he had made a mistake.
ex.zh: 虚荣心使他不愿承认自己犯了错误。

ex.en: The novel portrays a society ruined by greed and vanity.
ex.zh: 这部小说刻画了一个被贪婪和虚荣毁掉的社会。

ex.en: Water vapour in the atmosphere plays a crucial role in regulating the earth's temperature.
ex.zh: 大气中的水汽在调节地球温度方面起着至关重要的作用。

vari.usage: adj.各种各样的，形形色色的

ex.en: The amount of rainfall tends to vary considerably from one region to another.
ex.zh: 不同地区的降雨量往往差别很大。

senses: adj. 易变的，可变的，变量的
adj. 可变的，易变的，多变的
variable.usage: [族] variation n. 变化；变异；[近] changeable a. 易变的；adj.易变的，多变的 n.可变因素；变量；易混词辨析：variety表多样性强调特征；variation表变化强调过程；variable作名词表变量强调促使结果改变的因素；索引p419

ex.en: With so many variables, it is difficult to calculate the cost.
ex.zh: 有这么多的可变因素，很难计算出成本。

ex.en: Even though there is plenty of evidence that the quality of the teachers is the most important variable, teachers' unions have fought against getting rid of bad ones and promoting good ones.
ex.zh: 尽管有充足的证据表明，教师素质是（影响教育水平）最重要的变量，但教师工会还是反对开除差老师，提拔好老师。

ex.en: The weather in the mountains is highly variable, so climbers should carry extra clothing.
ex.zh: 山区天气多变，所以登山者应携带额外的衣物。

ex.en: In their model, interest rates are treated as the key variable.
ex.zh: 在他们的模型中，利率被视为关键变量。

ex.en: There is a noticeable variance between the students' predicted grades and their final examination results.
ex.zh: 学生的预测成绩与期末考试成绩之间存在明显差异。

senses: n. （数量、水平等的）变化；变体

ex.en: Will such variations bring about a change in the overall structure of the food and drink market?
ex.zh: 这种变化会带来饮料和食品市场整体结构的改变吗？

ex.en: There is considerable regional variation in the way people celebrate the festival.
ex.zh: 人们庆祝这一节日的方式存在很大的地区差异。

ex.en: Scientists recorded only slight variation in sea temperature over the past century.
ex.zh: 科学家记录到过去一个世纪里海水温度只有轻微变化。

ex.en: Genetic variation within a species helps it survive environmental change.
ex.zh: 物种内部的遗传变异有助于其在环境变化中存活。

ex.en: The shop sells a wide variety of imported cheeses and wines.
ex.zh: 这家商店出售种类繁多的进口奶酪和葡萄酒。

ex.en: Eating a variety of fresh vegetables is essential to a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 吃多种新鲜蔬菜对均衡饮食至关重要。

ex.en: This new variety of rice grows well in poor soil and resists disease.
ex.zh: 这种水稻新品种在贫瘠土壤中长势良好，并能抵抗病害。

senses: adj. 各种各样的，不同的

phrases.p: in various sections of the country

various.usage: 记：水果店里有各种(various)梨：有陈的、黄的、圆的、扁的。；辨析:varied可指包括不同方面的同一事物,后面名词可单可复;various指各种不同的人或事物,后面名词总用复数；adj.各种各样的；迥异的；索引p419

ex.en: To find out, the researchers controlled for various factors that might make firms more likely to invest—like size, industry, and sales—and for indicators that a place was desirable to live in, like growth in wages or population.
ex.zh: 为了弄清这一点，研究人员控制了可能会使公司更有可能投资的各种因素——比如规模、行业和销售状况——以及某地宜居的种种指标，比如薪资涨幅或人口增长。

ex.en: The museum holds various kinds of ancient coins from different dynasties.
ex.zh: 博物馆收藏着不同朝代的各种古钱币。

ex.en: The theory has been applied in various fields, from medicine to architecture.
ex.zh: 该理论已被应用于从医学到建筑的多个领域。

ex.en: The term is variously defined across the studies, making direct comparison difficult.
ex.zh: 各项研究对该术语的界定五花八门，使直接比较变得困难。

vary.usage: [扩]近 differ vi. 不同；[反] uniform a. 一致的；串词记忆：世界发生了非常(very)大的改变(vary)；索引p419

ex.en: Prices vary widely from shop to shop.
ex.zh: 每家商店的价格差别很大。

ex.en: The time needed in making decisions may vary according to the urgency of the situation.
ex.zh: 做决定所需的时间可能根据情况的紧急程度而有所不同。

ex.en: Teaching methods should vary with the age and ability of the students.
ex.zh: 教学方法应随学生的年龄和能力而变化。

ex.en: It is true that CEO pay has gone up—top ones may make 300 times the pay of typical workers on average, and since the mid-1970s, CEO pay for large publicly traded American corporations has, by varying estimates, gone up by about 500%.
ex.zh: 没错，首席执行官的薪酬上涨了——顶尖首席执行官的薪酬可能是普通员工平均薪酬的300倍，而且，据多方估计，自20世纪70年代中期以来，美国大型上市公司首席执行官的薪酬业已上涨了约500%。

ex.en: The antique vase, which had survived two centuries, was shattered during the move to the new museum.
ex.zh: 那只存世两百年的古董花瓶在搬往新博物馆的途中被打碎了。

vast.usage: 辨析:vast指面积或空间广度;immense形容规模程度数量极大;huge指相对常规的巨大;massive描述尺寸数量规模非常大；adj.巨大的，广大的；索引p419

ex.en: a vast data centre
ex.zh: 一个大型数据中心

ex.en: A vast majority of consumers now check online reviews before buying.
ex.zh: 现在，绝大多数消费者购买前都会查看网上评论。

ex.en: The vast plains of that region once supported huge herds of cattle.
ex.zh: 该地区辽阔的平原上曾放养着大群牛。

ex.en: Online learning platforms have vastly expanded access to higher education in remote regions.
ex.zh: 在线学习平台极大地扩大了偏远地区接受高等教育的机会。

senses: a. 被吹嘘的；被夸耀的

ex.en: The company's much-vaunted customer service failed conspicuously during last winter's delivery crisis.
ex.zh: 去年冬季配送危机期间，该公司被大肆吹嘘的客户服务明显失灵。

ex.en: The investigation revealed serious flaws in the way food safety inspections were carried out.
ex.zh: 调查揭示了食品安全检查执行方式中的严重缺陷。

ex.en: Nutritionists recommend filling half your plate with fruit and veg at every meal.
ex.zh: 营养学家建议每餐让蔬菜水果占据餐盘的一半。

ex.en: Fresh vegetable prices rose sharply after the drought reduced harvests across the region.
ex.zh: 干旱导致该地区收成减少后，新鲜蔬菜价格大幅上涨。

senses: n. 素食者,素食主义者
vegetarian.usage: veget(植物)+arian(表示人)→吃植物的人→素食者

ex.en: The restaurant added several vegetarian options to its menu after surveys showed growing demand among young diners.
ex.zh: 调查显示年轻食客的需求不断增长后，这家餐厅在菜单中增加了几道素食菜品。

ex.en: Much of the natural vegetation in the area has been destroyed by decades of intensive farming.
ex.zh: 该地区的大部分自然植被已被数十年的集约化农业毁坏。

vehicle.usage: [近] carriage n. 四轮马车；n.交通工具，车辆；工具；① n. 手段；索引p419

ex.en: Sadly, the spirit of inquiry once at home on campus has been replaced by the use of the humanities and social sciences as vehicles for publicizing "progressive", or left-liberal propaganda.
ex.zh: 可悲的是，国内校园中的探究精神已不复存在，取而代之的是将人文和社会科学当作宣传"进步思想"或"左倾自由"的手段。

ex.en: Electric vehicles are expected to replace petrol-driven ones within decades.
ex.zh: 预计几十年内，电动汽车将取代燃油汽车。

ex.en: Social media has become a powerful vehicle for political campaigns.
ex.zh: 社交媒体已成为政治运动的强大传播工具。

senses: n. 面纱,面罩;遮盖物;借口
veil.usage: 同义cover,mask,disguise;反义unveil v.显露,除去面纱；n.面纱，面罩；掩饰，借口 v.以面纱掩盖；遮盖，掩饰；adj.蒙面的；含蓄的 v.戴面纱；掩饰，遮掩

ex.en: A fine drizzle began to veil the hills.
ex.zh: 蒙蒙的细雨渐渐笼罩了群山。

ex.en: The bride lifted her veil and smiled at the guests.
ex.zh: 新娘掀起面纱，向宾客微笑。

ex.en: The company tried to veil its true intention behind a promise of charity.
ex.zh: 该公司试图用慈善承诺来掩饰其真实意图。

vein.usage: 派生veiny adj.有静脉的,有叶脉的

ex.en: The nurse struggled to find a vein in the patient's arm before finally drawing the blood sample.
ex.zh: 护士在病人手臂上费了一番周折才找到静脉，最终抽取了血样。

ex.en: The sensors measure the velocity of the wind at different heights to predict potential storms.
ex.zh: 传感器测量不同高度的风速，以预测可能发生的风暴。

ex.en: The theatre's velvet curtains, untouched for decades, were carefully restored by a team of specialists.
ex.zh: 剧院的天鹅绒幕布已几十年未曾动过，由一组专家精心修复。

ex.en: The government was forced to intervene when fuel supplies to the remote islands were disrupted.
ex.zh: 偏远岛屿的燃料供应中断后，政府被迫进行干预。

ex.en: Survivors demanded vengeance, but the courts insisted on a fair trial for the accused.
ex.zh: 幸存者要求报仇雪恨，但法院坚持对被告进行公正审判。

senses: v. 使通风,使空气流通
v. 公开讨论(问题,意见等)
v. 使（房间、建筑物等）通风；使通气；公开发表
ventilate.usage: 同义:air,refresh,discuss;派生:ventilation n.通风,通风设备；vent(风)+il+ate(动词后缀)→使通风

ex.en: The bathroom is ventilated by means of an extractor fan.
ex.zh: 这个浴室使用抽风扇通风。

ex.en: Open the windows regularly to ventilate the room and reduce the risk of mold.
ex.zh: 定期开窗给房间通风，以降低发霉的风险。

ex.en: The underground garage is ventilated by a system of powerful fans.
ex.zh: 地下停车场由大功率风扇系统通风。

ex.en: The committee meeting gave employees a chance to ventilate their concerns about the reform.
ex.zh: 委员会会议让员工有机会公开表达对改革的担忧。

senses: n. [U] 通风(设备)；空气流通(设备)
n. （对意见、问题、抱怨等的）公开讨论（或调查）

ex.en: Poor ventilation in crowded offices has been linked to headaches and lower concentration.
ex.zh: 拥挤办公室中通风不良与头痛和注意力下降有关。

ex.en: The new laboratory is equipped with an advanced ventilation system to protect researchers from harmful fumes.
ex.zh: 新实验室配备了先进的通风系统，以保护研究人员免受有害气体伤害。

ex.en: Building regulations now require natural ventilation in all newly constructed schools.
ex.zh: 建筑法规现在要求所有新建学校必须有自然通风。

senses: n. 冒险,冒险行动,投机行动,(冒险)事业
n. （尤指有风险的）企业，商业；经营项目
v. 冒险；敢于去（危险或令人不快的地方）；小心地说，谨慎地做
venture.usage: 辨析:venture冒险事业,动词指敢于;adventure指惊险经历,奇遇;同义:risk,attempt；派生adventure n.冒险，冒险经历；奇遇；联想记忆：和adventure(n.冒险)一起记忆；索引p419

ex.en: The directors of the company refused to undertake such a risky venture.
ex.zh: 公司董事拒绝承担这样一个有风险的经营项目。

ex.en: Starting a restaurant in a recession is a risky venture.
ex.zh: 在经济衰退时期开餐馆是一项冒险的事业。

ex.en: She ventured a guess about the outcome of the negotiation.
ex.zh: 她大着胆子猜了猜谈判的结果。

senses: n. (事件或活动的)发生地,场地,举办地点

ex.en: Organizers changed the conference venue at short notice because the original hall could not accommodate all delegates.
ex.zh: 由于原来的大厅无法容纳全体代表，组织者临时更改了会议场地。

ex.en: In English, the verb usually agrees with its subject in number and person.
ex.zh: 在英语中，动词通常在数和人称上与主语一致。

senses: adj. ①用言辞的，用文字的

ex.en: A verbal agreement is harder to prove than a written contract in most legal disputes.
ex.zh: 在大多数法律纠纷中，口头协议比书面合同更难证明。

ex.en: The candidate's strong verbal skills impressed the interviewers during the group discussion.
ex.zh: 候选人出色的口头表达能力在小组讨论中给面试官留下了深刻印象。

ex.en: Children develop verbal abilities rapidly when parents talk and read with them daily.
ex.zh: 当父母每天与他们交谈和阅读时，儿童的语言能力发展迅速。

ex.en: Applicants must confirm their acceptance in writing, not merely verbally.
ex.zh: 申请人必须以书面形式确认接受，不能仅作口头确认。

verdict.usage: [近] ruling n. 裁决；n.裁定，判决；意见，决定；ver（=verify，真实的）+dict（说）→说真实的话→引申为“公正，裁决”→结论；裁决，判决。；词根记忆: ver(true, 正确的)+dict(say, 说)→裁定原告说的话是否正确→裁定；索引p419

ex.en: The information commissioner, Elizabeth Denham, has issued her damning verdict against the Royal Free hospital trust under the NHS.
ex.zh: 英国信息官员伊丽莎白·德纳姆对国民健康服务(NHS)旗下的皇家自由信托医院做出了有罪裁定。

ex.en: After twelve hours of discussion, the jury finally reached a verdict of not guilty.
ex.zh: 经过十二个小时的讨论，陪审团最终作出无罪裁定。

ex.en: The verdict of consumers is clear: the product is overpriced and unreliable.
ex.zh: 消费者的结论很明确：这件产品定价过高且不可靠。

ex.en: Doctors waited for the test results before delivering their verdict on the treatment.
ex.zh: 医生们等检查结果出来后才对这种疗法作出判断。

ex.en: The company was on the verge of bankruptcy before a foreign investor agreed to provide emergency funding.
ex.zh: 在一位外国投资者同意提供紧急资金之前，该公司曾濒临破产。

ex.en: Scientific claims must rest on verifiable evidence rather than personal conviction.
ex.zh: 科学论断必须以可核实的证据为依据，而非个人信念。

senses: v. 核实，查对；证实，证明
verify.usage: [族] verification n. 核实；testify 的近义词；辨析（形近）：modify 修饰，限制；purify 净化，提炼；verify 证实；notify 通知；同义 confirm, attest, certify, prove；派生 verification n. 证实，查对；veri（真实）+fy

ex.en: However, the Justices said that Arizona police would be allowed to verify the legal status of people who come in contact with law enforcement.
ex.zh: 但是，大法官们说，亚利桑那州的州警可以在执法时核实相关人员的合法身份。

ex.en: According to the Knight Foundation survey, young people verify news by referring to diverse sources.
ex.zh: 根据奈特基金会的调查，年轻人通过查阅各种来源来核实新闻内容。

ex.en: The police verified the suspect's alibi.
ex.zh: 警方核实了嫌疑人的不在场证明。

ex.en: The scheme converts surplus food from supermarkets into meals for the homeless.
ex.zh: 该计划把超市的剩余食品转化为提供给无家可归者的餐食。

senses: adj. 多才多艺的；多用途的
有多种用途的,多功能的
adj. 多才多艺的；多功能的；多面手的，多用途的
versatile.usage: 派生versatility n.多才多艺,多功能；vers（转）+atile（易于……的）→易于转变，在哪儿都能转得开

ex.en: Eggs are easy to cook and are an extremely versatile food.
ex.zh: 鸡蛋容易烹煮，怎么做着吃都行。

ex.en: The smartphone has become a versatile tool that replaces cameras, maps, and wallets.
ex.zh: 智能手机已成为替代相机、地图和钱包的多功能工具。

ex.en: She is a versatile actress, equally convincing in comedy and tragedy.
ex.zh: 她是一位多才多艺的演员，演喜剧和悲剧同样有说服力。

ex.en: Bamboo is a versatile material used for building furniture, houses, and even bridges.
ex.zh: 竹子是一种用途广泛的材料，可用于制作家具、建造房屋甚至桥梁。

ex.en: The poem's final verse expresses the author's deep attachment to her rural childhood.
ex.zh: 这首诗的最后一节表达了作者对乡村童年的深深眷恋。

senses: n. ①型(式)，版本；变化形式(c)
n. 版本，译本；说法；变体，变种
version.usage: n.样式，型号；说法，描述； 版本

ex.en: The children read the novel in its abridged version.
ex.zh: 孩子们读的是这部小说的删节本。

ex.en: The final version of the software will be released next month.
ex.zh: 该软件的最终版本将于下月发布。

ex.en: The two witnesses gave conflicting versions of the accident.
ex.zh: 两名目击者对事故的说法相互矛盾。

senses: prep. (诉讼、竞赛等中)以……为对手
prep. 对抗；（比较两种不同想法、选择等）与…相对

phrases.p: the concept of man versus machine

versus.usage: 同义against;缩写vs.；各种比赛中常见的vs就是versus的缩写，表示"对抗"；词根记忆：vers(turn, 转)+us(我们)→我们转到对立面→对抗；索引p419

ex.en: The concept of man versus machine is at least as old as the industrial revolution.
ex.zh: "人机矛盾"这一概念至少可以追溯到工业革命时期。

ex.en: The match will be the champions versus a team of young challengers.
ex.zh: 这场比赛将是卫冕冠军对阵一支由年轻挑战者组成的队伍。

ex.en: Cost versus convenience is the central trade-off in online shopping.
ex.zh: 成本与便利的权衡是网上购物的核心取舍。

senses: adj. 垂直的,立式的;竖的;纵向的
adj. 垂直的，直立的，纵向的
vertical.usage: 反义horizontal adj.水平的;同义standing,steep；发音类似“我体考”→我在体考中做“垂直”引体向上→垂直的。

ex.en: The cliff was almost vertical.
ex.zh: 那悬崖几乎是笔直的。

ex.en: The tower's vertical design saves land while providing offices for thousands of workers.
ex.zh: 大楼的垂直设计节省了土地，同时为数千名员工提供办公空间。

ex.en: Climbers fixed ropes along the vertical face of the cliff before sunset.
ex.zh: 登山者在日落前沿悬崖的垂直面固定了绳索。

ex.en: The graph shows a vertical rise in online sales during the holiday season.
ex.zh: 图表显示假期期间在线销售额直线上升。

senses: ad. 非常，十分；完全，十足

ex.en: The very idea of privatizing the water supply provoked fierce opposition from local residents.
ex.zh: 仅仅是供水私有化这一想法，就激起了当地居民的强烈反对。

phrases.p: blow the vessels far off the course
the function of the blood vessels

vessel.usage: 记：轮船上装载着青铜时代的器皿。；n.船，舰；血管；容器，器皿 这个bay 上的很多建筑absorb 了欧洲architecture 的精髓，建筑横截面像被chop 了一样，旁边的翼楼cling 在其侧面。

ex.en: The museum displays an ancient clay vessel used for storing wine three thousand years ago.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了一件三千年前用于储酒的古代陶制器皿。

ex.en: A blood vessel in his brain burst, and doctors operated immediately to prevent permanent damage.
ex.zh: 他脑部的一根血管破裂，医生立即进行手术以防永久性损伤。

ex.en: The fishing vessel returned to port hours before the storm reached the coast.
ex.zh: 渔船在风暴抵达海岸前数小时返回港口。

senses: n. 背心,马甲,汗衫,内衣(c)

ex.en: Construction workers must wear a reflective vest on site to remain visible to passing vehicles.
ex.zh: 建筑工人在工地上必须穿反光背心，以便过往车辆能看见他们。

senses: n. 老兵；退伍军人；经验丰富的人
veteran.usage: 辨析:soldier多指现役军人;veteran指退伍老兵；索引p419

ex.en: The veteran journalist has covered elections for more than thirty years.
ex.zh: 这位资深记者报道选举已有三十多年。

ex.en: Veteran employees often guide newcomers through the unwritten rules of the workplace.
ex.zh: 资深员工常常引导新人了解职场中不成文的规则。

ex.en: The charity provides free medical care to veterans injured in past conflicts.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构为在过去冲突中受伤的老兵提供免费医疗。

senses: n. 否决,否决权,否决权的行使
veto.usage: 发音类似“未投”→没有给他投票，就是“否决”他→否决（权）；索引p419

ex.en: In theory, a girl may veto the spouse her parents have chosen.
ex.zh: 从理论上讲，一个女孩可以否决其父母选择的配偶。

ex.en: The president vetoed the bill passed by Congress last week.
ex.zh: 总统否决了国会上周通过的法案。

ex.en: Each of the five permanent members holds a veto in the Security Council.
ex.zh: 五个常任理事国在安理会各拥有一项否决权。

ex.en: The documents were delivered via a courier service after the postal strike ended.
ex.zh: 邮政罢工结束后，这些文件经由快递服务送达。

senses: prep. 经过（某一地方）；通过，凭借（某人、系统等）
via.usage: prep.经由，经过；通过，借助 于

ex.en: Many commuters now travel to work via high-speed rail instead of driving.
ex.zh: 如今许多通勤者乘高铁上班，而不是开车。

ex.en: The charity collects donations via its website and local volunteer centers.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构通过其网站和当地志愿者中心募集捐款。

ex.en: Students received the exam results via text message early on Monday morning.
ex.zh: 学生们周一清晨通过短信收到了考试结果。

viability.usage: n.生存能力，发育能力；可行 性

ex.en: Analysts have questioned the financial viability of the high-speed rail project.
ex.zh: 分析师质疑这一高铁项目在财务上的可行性。

senses: adj. 可实施的,切实可行的
adj. (生物等)能独立生存的,可生长发育的
adj. 可行的；能独立发展的
viable.usage: adj.可望成功的，可行的；能 存活的；索引p419

ex.en: Creating positive habits is a huge part of improving our consumers' lives, and it's essential to making new products commercially viable.
ex.zh: 培养良好的习惯是提高我们消费者的生活水平的重要方面，这对于新产品在商业上可行是至关重要的。

ex.en: Without government subsidies, the high-speed rail project would hardly be commercially viable.
ex.zh: 没有政府补贴，这个高铁项目在商业上几乎难以维系。

ex.en: It remains doubtful whether the start-up can grow into a viable business.
ex.zh: 这家初创企业能否发展成一家能够自立生存的企业仍存疑问。

senses: a. 鲜艳的；充满生机的；响亮的

ex.en: The city's vibrant cultural scene attracts young graduates from all over the country.
ex.zh: 这座城市生机勃勃的文化氛围吸引着全国各地的年轻毕业生。

vibrate.usage: 辨析:vibrate强调振动频率快但移动位置极小;shake为普通用语,含摇晃之意

ex.en: The atmosphere seemed to vibrate with tension.
ex.zh: 气氛似乎紧张得发颤。

ex.en: The phone is set to vibrate during meetings so that it will not disturb the speakers.
ex.zh: 会议期间手机被设置为振动，以免打扰发言者。

ex.en: When heavy trucks pass by, the old bridge is felt to vibrate slightly under the load.
ex.zh: 重型卡车驶过时，可以感到旧桥在荷载下轻微振动。

ex.en: The strings of the instrument vibrate at different frequencies to produce distinct notes.
ex.zh: 乐器的琴弦以不同频率振动，发出不同的音。

senses: n. 震动，颤动；抖动；（感情的）共鸣

ex.en: Engineers measured the vibration of the bridge deck as heavy lorries passed over it.
ex.zh: 工程师们测量了重型卡车驶过时桥面的震动。

senses: n. [U] （与性或毒品有关的）罪行
vice.usage: 记：不管是小的恶行还是大的罪行，我们都绝不纵容。

ex.en: The report argues that gambling remains a social vice that traps thousands of low-income families in debt.
ex.zh: 报告指出，赌博仍是一种社会恶习，使成千上万的低收入家庭陷入债务。

senses: n. 周围地区，临近地区

ex.en: Several new restaurants have opened in the vicinity of the university campus.
ex.zh: 大学校园附近新开了几家餐馆。

ex.en: Police warned residents to stay indoors because a dangerous animal had been seen in the vicinity.
ex.zh: 警方警告居民待在室内，因为附近发现了一只危险动物。

ex.en: House prices in the vicinity of good schools are noticeably higher than elsewhere.
ex.zh: 好学校附近的房价明显高于其他地方。

senses: adj. 邪恶的，恶毒的，凶残的，堕落的
adj. 恶性的；剧烈的；凶险的
vicious.usage: 同义 evil，wicked，sinful，savage，cruel；反义 virtuous adj. 善良的；索引p419

ex.en: The politician suffered a vicious personal attack on social media during the campaign.
ex.zh: 竞选期间，这位政治家在社交媒体上遭到恶毒的人身攻击。

ex.en: Unemployment and poverty can form a vicious cycle that is hard to break without government support.
ex.zh: 失业和贫困会形成恶性循环，没有政府支持很难打破。

ex.en: The village was hit by a vicious storm that destroyed roofs and cut off electricity.
ex.zh: 猛烈的风暴袭击了村庄，掀翻屋顶并切断了电力。

victim.usage: n.受害者，罹难者；祭品；索引p419

ex.en: The importance of education in poor countries has fallen victim of bias.
ex.zh: 教育的重要性在贫穷国家已成为偏见的牺牲品。

ex.en: The police are still searching for the victims of the motorway crash.
ex.zh: 警方仍在寻找高速公路撞车事故的受害者。

ex.en: Elderly people are frequently the victims of telephone fraud.
ex.zh: 老年人经常成为电话诈骗的受害者。

ex.en: Small shops often fall victim to the expansion of online retailers.
ex.zh: 小商店常常沦为网络零售商扩张的牺牲品。

ex.en: The team celebrated its victory in the national championship after a decade of failures.
ex.zh: 在经历了十年失败之后，球队庆祝了全国锦标赛的胜利。

ex.en: The new vaccine was described as a significant victory in the fight against the disease.
ex.zh: 新疫苗被誉为抗击该疾病的一个重大胜利。

ex.en: Winning by cheating is no victory at all, as it destroys the meaning of the game.
ex.zh: 靠作弊取胜根本算不上胜利，因为它摧毁了比赛的意义。

ex.en: The report presents visual evidence that the glacier has retreated by nearly two kilometres.
ex.zh: 报告以直观证据表明冰川已消退近两公里。

senses: adj. 电视的,视频的,录像的

ex.en: Police examined video footage from nearby shops to identify the suspects involved in the robbery.
ex.zh: 警方调取了附近商店的录像，以确认抢劫案涉及的嫌疑人。

ex.en: Vietnam has become one of the fastest-growing manufacturing centres in Southeast Asia.
ex.zh: 越南已成为东南亚发展最快的制造业中心之一。

view.usage: 记：依我看(view)，他发表对这件风景(view)画的见解很有见地。；小记：take a longer view 从更长远的角度来看；2020年翻译例：the geo-centric view that the Earth was at the centre of our universe 地心说的观点；索引p419

ex.en: People came from all over the world to view her work.
ex.zh: 人们从世界各地涌来欣赏她的作品。

ex.en: Mental health allows us to view others with sympathy if they are having troubles, with kindness if they are in pain, and with unconditional love no matter who they are.
ex.zh: 精神健康使我们在他人身处困境时充满同情，在他人痛苦不堪时心怀善意，而且无论对谁，都能献出无条件的爱。

ex.en: From the top of the tower you can enjoy a splendid view of the old city.
ex.zh: 从塔顶你可以饱览老城的壮丽景色。

ex.en: In my view, the plan is practical but requires far more funding.
ex.zh: 在我看来，这个计划可行，但需要多得多的资金。

ex.en: Individuals interviewed represented different viewpoints.
ex.zh: 被采访的每个人都代表了不同的观点。

ex.en: From a historical viewpoint, the industrial revolution marked a sharp break with the past.
ex.zh: 从历史角度看，工业革命标志着与过去的急剧决裂。

ex.en: The report tries to present the issue from the viewpoint of ordinary workers.
ex.zh: 该报告试图从普通劳动者的角度呈现这一问题。

senses: adj. 有力的,精力旺盛的
adj. 精力充沛的；强壮的
vigorous.usage: 发音类似"喂个肉"→妈妈喂肉吃身体强壮→强壮的

ex.en: Take vigorous exercise for several hours a week.
ex.zh: 每周做几个小时剧烈运动。

ex.en: The government promised vigorous action against companies that dump waste into rivers.
ex.zh: 政府承诺对向河流倾倒废物的公司采取有力行动。

ex.en: Regular vigorous exercise strengthens the heart and improves the quality of sleep.
ex.zh: 定期进行剧烈运动能增强心脏功能并改善睡眠质量。

ex.en: The proposal met vigorous opposition from local farmers worried about losing their land.
ex.zh: 该提案遭到担心失去土地的当地农民的强烈反对。

senses: adv. 强烈地；精力旺盛地

ex.en: The opposition has vigorously opposed the plan to build a new airport near the wetlands.
ex.zh: 反对派有力地反对在湿地附近修建新机场的计划。

ex.en: She was a wonderful, bubbly girl, full of vigour.
ex.zh: 她是个了不起的女孩，乐天活泼，活力四射。

ex.en: Rental prices for a seaside villa peak during the summer holiday season.
ex.zh: 海滨别墅的租金在暑期达到高峰。

ex.en: The village has changed little over the past century, apart from the arrival of electricity and paved roads.
ex.zh: 除了通电和修筑柏油路之外，这个村庄在过去一个世纪里变化不大。

ex.en: The data failed to convince the sceptics, who demanded far larger trials.
ex.zh: 这些数据未能让那些要求开展规模大得多的试验的怀疑者信服。

ex.en: Growers say this year's cool spring produced grapes of exceptional quality on the vine.
ex.zh: 种植者说，今年凉爽的春季使葡萄在藤上结出了极佳的品质。

ex.en: The recipe recommends adding a spoonful of vinegar to balance the sweetness of the sauce.
ex.zh: 食谱建议加一勺醋，以平衡酱汁的甜味。

ex.en: The court found the company in violation of environmental regulations.
ex.zh: 法院认定该公司违反了环境法规。

senses: v. 违反，违背；侵犯；亵渎
violate.usage: viol（力量）+ate→用力量对待→侵犯。近义：breach vt. 违反；对无辜贫民使用暴力(violence)，违反(violate)了法律的规定；violate 违反（法律/协议）；violation n. 违反。；索引p419

ex.en: For example, it is unclear whether the sequencing of a whole genome violates the patents of individual genes within it.
ex.zh: 比如说，整个基因组序列是否违背了其中单个基因的专利仍无定论。

ex.en: Those who violate the rules will be punished.
ex.zh: 违反规则者将受到惩罚。

ex.en: It also pledged not to deploy AI whose use would violate international laws or human rights.
ex.zh: 同时，它(指谷歌)也承诺不会利用可能违反国际法或人权的人工智能技术。

senses: n. 狂热,强烈的感情;激烈,猛烈

ex.en: Our organization works with victims of violence.
ex.zh: 我们的组织与暴力受害者合作。

ex.en: The police were praised for containing the violence without firing a shot.
ex.zh: 警方因未开一枪就遏制了暴力而受到称赞。

ex.en: Parents worry that violence on television may harm young children.
ex.zh: 家长担心电视上的暴力内容会伤害幼童。

senses: a. 暴力的；暴力引起的
a. 带有强烈感情的；激烈的
adj. 强暴的,暴力引起的
violent.usage: [扩]词族 violence n. 暴力；violently ad. 猛烈地；拓展：domestic violence 家庭暴力；派生violence n.暴力

ex.en: Children should not be allowed to watch violent movies.
ex.zh: 不应允许儿童看暴力电影。

ex.en: The film was criticized for its violent scenes, though many critics praised its storytelling.
ex.zh: 这部电影因暴力场面受到批评，尽管许多评论家称赞其叙事。

ex.en: A violent storm struck the coastal town, overturning cars and uprooting trees.
ex.zh: 一场猛烈的风暴袭击了沿海小镇，掀翻汽车并连根拔起树木。

ex.en: Researchers found no simple link between violent games and aggressive behavior in teenagers.
ex.zh: 研究人员发现暴力游戏与青少年攻击行为之间没有简单的联系。

senses: adj. 野生紫罗兰色的;蓝紫色的

ex.en: Wild violets carpet the forest floor in early spring, attracting photographers from across the region.
ex.zh: 早春时节，野生紫罗兰铺满林间地面，吸引了来自各地的摄影师。

ex.en: The young musician began learning the violin at the age of four and gave her first public concert at ten.
ex.zh: 这位年轻音乐家四岁开始学小提琴，十岁便举办了首场公开音乐会。

ex.en: The airport has opened a separate lounge for VIP passengers and visiting delegations.
ex.zh: 机场为要客和来访代表团开设了单独的休息室。

senses: adj. 纯净的,原始的,未开垦的
n. 处女,未婚女子;童男

ex.en: The government has pledged to protect the region's virgin forests from commercial logging companies.
ex.zh: 政府承诺保护该地区的原始森林免遭商业采伐公司的破坏。

ex.en: The concert hall was virtually full an hour before the performance began.
ex.zh: 开演前一小时，音乐厅几乎已经座无虚席。

senses: adj. 实际上的,事实上的;(计)虚拟的
adj. 实质上的；虚拟的；模拟的
virtual.usage: 同义: real, actual；adj.几乎……的，实质上的； 虚拟的；词根记忆：vir(man,男人)+tual→有男子汉气概的→“气概”是一种摸不到的品格→虚拟的；索引p419

ex.en: The best uses of 3D printers and virtual reality haven't been invented yet.
ex.zh: 3D打印机和虚拟现实的最佳用途还没有发明出来。

ex.en: The museum now offers virtual tours for pupils in remote villages.
ex.zh: 博物馆现在为偏远村庄的小学生提供虚拟参观。

ex.en: The country enjoys a virtual monopoly in the global market for rare metals.
ex.zh: 该国在全球稀有金属市场享有事实上的垄断地位。

ex.en: Online platforms give students virtual access to millions of academic papers.
ex.zh: 在线平台使学生可以虚拟访问数百万篇学术论文。

senses: adv. 事实上；几乎；实质上

ex.en: Unfortunately, these critics are virtually forgotten.
ex.zh: 不幸的是，这些评论家几乎被遗忘了。

ex.en: Plus, virtually all major American companies are becoming tech companies.
ex.zh: 而且，几乎所有的美国大公司都在转变成科技公司。

ex.en: The two products are virtually identical in quality, though they differ greatly in price.
ex.zh: 这两种产品质量几乎完全相同，尽管价格相差很大。

ex.en: Remote sensing technology has made it possible to monitor virtually every forest on Earth.
ex.zh: 遥感技术使监测地球上几乎每一片森林成为可能。

phrases.p: trust the fundamental virtue of our economy
phrases.m: 相信我国经济的基本优点

virtue.usage: [扩]近 merit n. 优点；[反] vice n. 缺点；记：这张阁楼照片极好地展现了virtue（美德、优点）这个词。；同义: morality, merit, goodness; 反义: vice；n.高尚的道德；美德；优点， 长处；vi(罗马数字VI)+r(花)+tue→六朵花→小红花越多优点美德越多；索引

ex.en: He understands the traditional virtue of hard work.
ex.zh: 他懂得勤劳这一传统美德。

ex.en: But completeness is no longer a virtue in the newspaper business.
ex.zh: 但包罗万象已不再是报纸行业的优势。

ex.en: Patience is a virtue that modern society seems to have forgotten.
ex.zh: 耐心是现代社会似乎已经遗忘的一种美德。

ex.en: The scheme has the virtue of simplicity, though it is far from perfect.
ex.zh: 该方案具有简单的优点，尽管它远非完美。

senses: a. 有道德的；自命不凡的
virtuous.usage: adj.道德高尚的，品行端正的

ex.en: Politicians often present themselves as virtuous guardians of public morality, yet rarely live up to that image.
ex.zh: 政客们常把自己标榜为道德高尚的公共守护者，却很少达到那种形象。

senses: n. 病毒,(精神、道德方面的)有害影响
virus.usage: vi(围)+r(热)+us(我们)→病毒围绕使我们发热→病毒；索引p419

ex.en: In fact, a virus emerged in the 1970s that could have been just that fatal.
ex.zh: 事实上，20世纪70年代出现了一种病毒，这种病毒可能非常致命。

ex.en: The computer virus deleted important files across the whole network.
ex.zh: 这种电脑病毒删除了整个网络中的重要文件。

ex.en: The new virus spreads quickly in crowded, poorly ventilated spaces.
ex.zh: 这种新病毒在拥挤、通风不良的空间里传播很快。

ex.en: Applicants for a student visa must prove they have sufficient funds to cover tuition and living costs.
ex.zh: 申请学生签证者必须证明自己有足够的资金支付学费和生活费。

ex.en: Knowing the results of Epley's study, it makes sense that many people hate photographs of themselves viscerally.
ex.zh: 了解了埃普利的这些研究成果，就不难理解为何许多人发自内心地不喜欢自己的照片了。

ex.en: Thick fog reduced visibility on the motorway to less than fifty metres, causing a series of accidents.
ex.zh: 浓雾使高速公路上的能见度降至不足五十米，引发了一连串事故。

visible.usage: adj.明显的，引人注目的；可 见的；vis(表示"看")+ible(形容词后缀，表示"可以……的")→可视的，可以看见的→看得见的，明显的；索引p419

ex.en: There is no visible evidence to support his idea.
ex.zh: 没有明显的证据支持他的观点。

ex.en: These changes were gradual and at first scarcely visible.
ex.zh: 这些变化是缓慢的，而且一开始几乎察觉不出。

ex.en: The damage to the engine was barely visible until the machine was taken apart.
ex.zh: 在机器被拆开之前，发动机的损坏几乎看不出来。

ex.en: The economic impact of the crisis is now visible in every major industry.
ex.zh: 这场危机的经济影响如今在每一个主要行业都清晰可见。

ex.en: The minister was visibly nervous when journalists pressed her on the delayed housing reforms.
ex.zh: 当记者们就搁置的住房改革追问部长时，她明显很紧张。

senses: n. 视力；想象，幻象；视野
n. 视野；想象；远见卓识；视力
vision.usage: n.幻象；视力；视野；vis(看)+ion(表名词)→视野；视力；联想记忆：有本杂志叫作《Vista看天下》，即可记住vis有“看”的意思；索引p419

ex.en: His plans for the country's future show a remarkable breadth of vision.
ex.zh: 他对国家未来的构想显示了他的远见卓识。

ex.en: Fantasies of great wealth often involve visions of fancy cars and extravagant homes.
ex.zh: 对于巨额财富的幻想常常会包含对豪车和豪宅的幻象。

ex.en: The founder had a clear vision of how technology could transform education.
ex.zh: 创始人对技术如何变革教育有着清晰的构想。

ex.en: Regular eye tests are advised for anyone whose vision has deteriorated.
ex.zh: 建议任何视力下降的人都定期检查眼睛。

senses: a. 有远见卓识的；梦幻的

ex.en: The company's founder was a visionary who anticipated the shift to mobile computing years before competitors.
ex.zh: 公司创始人是一位有远见的人，早在竞争对手多年之前就预见到了向移动计算的转变。

ex.en: Officials plan to visit several coastal towns to assess the damage caused by last month's storms.
ex.zh: 官员们计划走访几个沿海城镇，评估上月风暴造成的损失。

senses: n. 访问者,客人,来宾,参观者

ex.en: The gallery restricts the number of visitors per hour to protect the paintings from humidity.
ex.zh: 美术馆限制每小时的参观人数，以保护画作免受潮湿侵害。

visual.usage: adj.视觉的，视力的 n.视觉资料；索引p419

ex.en: The report uses striking visual images to present the data.
ex.zh: 这份报告用醒目的视觉图像来呈现数据。

ex.en: The theatre's visual effects impressed the audience as much as the music did.
ex.zh: 这家剧院的视觉效果给观众留下的印象不亚于音乐。

ex.en: Good slide design relies on strong visual contrast rather than dense text.
ex.zh: 好的幻灯片设计依靠强烈的视觉对比，而不是密集的文字。

senses: v. 可视化；使形象化；构思，设想
visualise.usage: visual(视力的)+ise(动词后缀，使……化)→使看到→可视化；形象化；书中亦作visualize

ex.en: She couldn't visualise climbing the mountain.
ex.zh: 她想象不出如何攀登这座大山。

ex.en: Visualize how you would like it to end instead; the next time it occurs, try to wake up just enough to control its course.
ex.zh: 设想一下你希望它（指梦）怎么结束，下次再做同样的梦时，试着醒过来，这样刚好可以控制它的进程。

ex.en: Architects use software that lets clients visualise the finished building before construction starts.
ex.zh: 建筑师使用的软件能让客户在开工前想象出建成后的建筑。

senses: vt. 使形象化；想象；设想

ex.en: Architects use three-dimensional models to help clients visualize the finished building before construction begins.
ex.zh: 建筑师利用三维模型帮助客户在开工前直观地想象建成后的建筑。

senses: v. 使形象化;想象,设想

ex.en: Teachers encourage pupils to visualize the problem before attempting the calculation.
ex.zh: 教师鼓励学生在动笔计算之前先在头脑中设想问题。

ex.en: Regular exercise is vital to maintaining both physical and mental health in later life.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼对保持晚年的身心健康至关重要。

senses: a. 至关重要的；生死攸关的
a. 生命的；维持生命所必需的
a. 极重要的；必不可少的
vital.usage: vit(生命)+-al→关乎生命的→生死攸关的；[族] vitality n. 活力；crucial 的近义词；adj.至关重要的，必不可少的； 生机勃勃的，充满活力的；vit(生命)+al(形容词后缀)→有生命的→生气勃勃的；词根记忆：vit(live, life,生命)+al(形容词后缀)→生命的→有活力的；索引p

ex.en: So it will be vital to prioritize areas at greatest risk of fire or drought.
ex.zh: 因此优先处理火灾或干旱风险最大的区域是至关重要的。

ex.en: This is why repeated attempts at reform legislation have failed in recent years, leaving the Postal Service unable to pay its bills except by deferring vital modernization.
ex.zh: 这就是近年来试图改革法案屡次受挫的原因，它导致美国邮政署无力偿付其债务，只能推迟必要的现代化进程。

ex.en: Fresh water is vital to the survival of every community in the desert region.
ex.zh: 淡水对该沙漠地区每个社区的生存都至关重要。

ex.en: It is vital that all patients understand the risks before signing the consent form.
ex.zh: 至关重要的是，所有患者在签署同意书前都了解相关风险。

ex.en: Regular physical activity helps older adults maintain their vitality and independence.
ex.zh: 定期的体育活动有助于老年人保持活力和独立生活能力。

ex.en: The city center regained its vitality after old warehouses were converted into shops and studios.
ex.zh: 旧仓库改建为商店和工作室后，市中心恢复了活力。

ex.en: A language loses its vitality when young people stop speaking it in daily life.
ex.zh: 当年轻人不再在日常生活中使用一种语言时，它就失去了活力。

ex.en: Doctors advise a balanced diet as the best source of vitamins for most healthy adults.
ex.zh: 医生建议均衡饮食是大多数健康成人最佳的维生素来源。

ex.en: Lack of sunlight in winter can lead to vitamin D deficiency in northern countries.
ex.zh: 冬季阳光不足可能导致北方国家的人缺乏维生素D。

ex.en: The breakfast cereal is fortified with extra vitamins and minerals for growing children.
ex.zh: 这种早餐谷物添加了额外的维生素和矿物质，适合成长中的儿童。

ex.en: Conservationists are working to revive the threatened wetland ecosystem.
ex.zh: 自然保护工作者正努力恢复这片受威胁的湿地生态系统。

senses: a. （光线、色彩）鲜艳的，鲜明的
adj. 生动的，逼真的；鲜艳的；鲜明的
vivid.usage: 扩：vividly ad. 生动地；adj.生动的，逼真的；鲜艳的；发音类似“娓娓地”→娓娓道来，很生动→生动的。；索引p419

ex.en: Powerful memory doesn't make my emotions any more acute or vivid.
ex.zh: 强大的记忆并不能让我的情感更为强烈或更为鲜明。

ex.en: The novelist gives a vivid description of life in a fishing village.
ex.zh: 这位小说家对渔村生活作了生动的描写。

ex.en: She still retains a vivid recollection of her first day at school.
ex.zh: 她对上学的第一天仍记忆犹新。

ex.en: The poster uses vivid colors to catch the attention of passers-by.
ex.zh: 海报用鲜艳的色彩吸引路人的注意。

ex.en: The retired miner still vividly remembers the day the pit finally closed.
ex.zh: 这位退休矿工仍清晰地记得矿井最终关闭的那一天。

ex.en: Teachers who advocate smaller classes argue that children receive more individual attention.
ex.zh: 提倡小班教学的教师认为，这样孩子们能得到更多个别关注。

senses: n. 词汇,词汇量,词汇表

ex.en: Reading widely is the most effective way to expand one's vocabulary beyond the limits of textbooks.
ex.zh: 广泛阅读是扩展词汇量、突破教科书范围的最有效方法。

senses: adj. 声音的,有声的;口头的;歌唱的
adj. 大声表达的，直言不讳的；发声的
vocal.usage: 助记:voc(声音)+al(形容词后缀)→声音的；索引p419

ex.en: Parents have been vocal in their opposition to the plan to close the village school.
ex.zh: 家长们对关闭乡村学校的计划直言反对。

ex.en: She has been a vocal supporter of animal rights for more than a decade.
ex.zh: 十多年来，她一直是动物权利的坚定公开支持者。

ex.en: The singer is famous not only for her vocal range but also for her charity work.
ex.zh: 这位歌手不仅以音域著称，还以慈善工作闻名。

senses: n. 工作，职业；信心；使命感
vocation.usage: 派生vocational adj.职业的；n.使命感；工作，职业；神召；很多人假期（vacation）的时候，会找一些兼职的工作（vocation）

ex.en: He has a vocation for teaching.
ex.zh: 他是教书的材料。

ex.en: Nursing is a vocation that demands patience as much as skill.
ex.zh: 护理是一份既需要技能也需要耐心的职业。

ex.en: She abandoned a profitable law career to follow her vocation as a teacher.
ex.zh: 她放弃了收入丰厚的律师职业，去追寻自己当教师的使命。

senses: adj. 职业的，职业技术的

ex.en: Vocational training programs help school leavers acquire practical skills demanded by local industries.
ex.zh: 职业培训项目帮助离校生获得当地行业所需的实用技能。

ex.en: Critics argue that vocational education receives far less funding than academic universities.
ex.zh: 批评者认为职业教育获得的经费远少于学术型大学。

ex.en: The college offers vocational courses in nursing, welding, and computer repair.
ex.zh: 该学院提供护理、焊接和计算机维修等职业课程。

voice.usage: 词组voice one's opinions发表意见

ex.en: Consumer groups have voiced strong concerns about the safety standards of imported toys.
ex.zh: 消费者团体对进口玩具的安全标准表示了强烈担忧。

senses: ②(of) 无效的；没有的，缺乏的

ex.en: The court declared the contract void because one party had signed it under false pretences.
ex.zh: 法院宣布该合同无效，因为一方是在被欺骗的情况下签署的。

ex.en: The historian's third volume covers the war years in unprecedented detail.
ex.zh: 这位历史学家的第三卷以前所未有的详尽程度记述了战争年代。

senses: a. 易变的；无定性的；不稳定的；易挥发的
adj. (人或其情绪)易变的,无常性的
adj. (情况)可能急剧波动的,不稳定的
adj. (物质)易挥发的,易发散的
adj. 不稳定的；易变的；易挥发的
volatile.usage: 同义unstable;派生volatility n.挥发性;反复无常；索引p419

ex.en: Energy prices have been extremely volatile this year, making it hard for companies to plan their budgets.
ex.zh: 今年能源价格波动剧烈，使公司难以编制预算。

ex.en: Investors withdrew from the volatile stock market and put their money into government bonds.
ex.zh: 投资者撤出动荡的股市，将资金转入政府债券。

ex.en: She has a volatile temper, so her colleagues try to avoid arguing with her in meetings.
ex.zh: 她脾气多变，因此同事们在会议上尽量避免与她争执。

senses: adj. 火山(性)的;暴烈的,猛烈的

ex.en: The island's volcanic soil is exceptionally fertile, supporting crops that cannot grow elsewhere in the country.
ex.zh: 该岛的火山土壤异常肥沃，能种植全国其他地方无法生长的作物。

ex.en: The volcano erupted without warning, forcing thousands of villagers to flee their homes.
ex.zh: 火山毫无征兆地喷发，迫使数千村民逃离家园。

ex.en: Scientists monitor the volcano closely for signs of rising gas and small earthquakes.
ex.zh: 科学家密切监测这座火山，寻找气体增多和小型地震的迹象。

ex.en: Fertile soil around the volcano attracts farmers despite the obvious risks of living nearby.
ex.zh: 尽管在附近生活有明显风险，火山周围肥沃的土壤仍吸引着农民。

ex.en: Beach volleyball has grown into a professional sport that attracts substantial sponsorship and television coverage.
ex.zh: 沙滩排球已发展成为一项职业运动，吸引了大量赞助和电视报道。

ex.en: The manual warns users never to connect the machine to a 110 volt outlet, as this may damage the motor.
ex.zh: 手册警告用户切勿将机器接到110伏特的插座上，否则可能损坏电机。

ex.en: Fluctuations in voltage during thunderstorms can seriously damage sensitive electronic equipment.
ex.zh: 雷雨期间电压的波动会严重损坏精密电子设备。

ex.en: The evolution of online retail has forced shopping centres to rethink their role.
ex.zh: 网络零售的演变迫使购物中心重新思考自身的定位。

ex.en: The library stores each volume of the encyclopedia in a climate-controlled room to prevent decay.
ex.zh: 图书馆将百科全书的每一卷都存放在恒温恒湿的房间里，以防损毁。

ex.en: The charity depends almost entirely on volunteers to deliver meals to elderly residents.
ex.zh: 这家慈善机构几乎完全依靠志愿者为老年居民送餐。

senses: adj. 自愿的,志愿的,义务的
adj. 自愿的；自发的；志愿的；无偿的
voluntary.usage: 词根记忆：vol(will, 意愿)+un+t+ary(nature, 自然)→按照意愿顺其自然的→自愿的；索引p419

ex.en: Attendance at the evening lectures is entirely voluntary.
ex.zh: 晚间的讲座完全自愿参加。

ex.en: The charity relies on voluntary donations from the public.
ex.zh: 这家慈善机构依靠公众的自发捐赠。

ex.en: Many retirees take on voluntary work in their communities.
ex.zh: 许多退休者在社区从事志愿工作。

senses: n. 志愿者,自愿参加者
n. 志愿者，志愿兵；义务工作者
v. 自愿做；义务做；主动建议（或告诉）

ex.en: He volunteered as a tutor of immigrant children.
ex.zh: 他自愿做移民儿童的家庭教师。

ex.en: Unintentional harm-doers will not be prosecuted if they volunteer to set up an equally big habitat.
ex.zh: 如果出于无心而伤害了（该鸟类）的人自愿建立一个同样大的栖息地，他们将不会被起诉。

ex.en: More than two hundred volunteers helped clean up the beach after the storm.
ex.zh: 风暴过后，两百多名志愿者帮助清理了海滩。

ex.en: The investigation involves interviewing everyone who had access to the laboratory.
ex.zh: 这项调查包括约谈所有能进入实验室的人员。

vote.usage: vote through 投票通过;同义poll,ballot；发音类似“我投”→选班长我投了他一票→投票；票；索引p419

ex.en: On a five to three vote, the Supreme Court knocked out much of Arizona's immigration law Monday.
ex.zh: 周一，最高法院以五比三的投票结果否决了亚利桑那州移民法的主要内容。

ex.en: With Britain voting to leave the European Union, and GDP already predicted to slow as a result, it is now a timely moment to assess what he was referring to.
ex.zh: 随着英国投票脱离欧盟，人们早已预计国内生产总值(GDP)也会因此放缓，现在正是评估他(指肯尼迪)言下之意的好时机。

ex.en: Parliament will vote on the new education bill next week.
ex.zh: 议会下周将就新的教育法案进行表决。

ex.en: Young voters turned out in record numbers, and their votes decided the outcome.
ex.zh: 年轻选民投票人数创纪录，他们的选票决定了结果。

ex.en: Independent voters could decide the outcome of next month's election, pollsters say.
ex.zh: 民调专家称，独立选民可能决定下月选举的结果。

voyage.usage: 词组go on a voyage航海去

ex.en: The ship's record-breaking voyage across the Atlantic demonstrated the reliability of the new engine design.
ex.zh: 这艘船横渡大西洋的破纪录航行证明了新发动机设计的可靠性。

senses: adj. 粗俗的,庸俗的,普通的
adj. 粗俗的，庸俗的；不雅的
vulgar.usage: 这个乞丐（beggar）的行为有些粗俗（vulgar）

ex.en: What has happened is that people cannot confess fully to their dreams, lest they be thought pushing, acquisitive and vulgar.
ex.zh: 现在的情况是，人们不能完全承认自己的梦想，唯恐别人认为自己咄咄逼人、贪婪和庸俗。

ex.en: The comedian was criticized for making vulgar jokes during a televised charity event.
ex.zh: 这位喜剧演员因在电视直播的慈善活动中开粗俗玩笑而受到批评。

ex.en: Some regard displaying wealth loudly as vulgar, while others see it as personal freedom.
ex.zh: 有些人认为炫耀财富粗俗不堪，而另一些人则视之为个人自由。

ex.en: The novel describes how the newly rich tried to hide their vulgar manners.
ex.zh: 这部小说描写了新富们如何试图掩饰自己粗俗的举止。

ex.en: Older people living alone are particularly vulnerable to financial scams conducted by phone.
ex.zh: 独居老人特别容易成为电话金融诈骗的目标。

ex.en: The flood exposed the vulnerability of coastal cities that were built below sea level.
ex.zh: 洪水暴露了建在海平面以下的沿海城市的脆弱性。

ex.en: Admitting one's vulnerability, psychologists argue, is the first step toward genuine human connection.
ex.zh: 心理学家认为，承认自身的脆弱是建立真正人际联系的第一步。

ex.en: The report highlights the vulnerability of small farmers to sudden changes in global prices.
ex.zh: 报告强调了小农户面对全球价格突变的脆弱性。

senses: adj. 易受攻击的,易受伤的,脆弱的
adj. 脆弱的，易受伤害的
adj. 脆弱的；易受伤害的
vulnerable.usage: 词根记忆: vuln(wound, 伤害)+er+able(易于…的)→易受伤害的；索引p419

ex.en: These jobs are so vulnerable to technology in the first place.
ex.zh: 这些工作从一开始就如此容易受到技术的影响。

ex.en: Brynjolfsson and McAfee miss the reason why these jobs are so vulnerable to technology in the first place.
ex.zh: 布林约尔弗森和麦凯菲没有讨论这些工作从一开始就在机器面前不堪一击的原因。

ex.en: Children in poor rural areas are especially vulnerable to infectious diseases.
ex.zh: 贫困农村地区的儿童特别容易感染传染性疾病。

ex.en: The old bridge is vulnerable to collapse during a major earthquake.
ex.zh: 这座老桥在大地震中容易倒塌。

ex.en: A typical phone charger left plugged in overnight draws only a few watts of electricity.
ex.zh: 手机充电器整夜插在插座上通常只消耗几瓦的电力。

senses: v. 跋涉,涉水,蹚;费力地阅读

ex.en: Rescuers had to wade through floodwater to reach families trapped on the upper floors.
ex.zh: 救援人员不得不蹚过洪水，去营救被困在楼上的人家。

wage.usage: 辨析:wage体力劳动者工资,常按周计,多用复数;salary脑力劳动者薪金,按月/年付;pay指任何工作所得收入,最通俗

ex.en: In many rich countries average wages in the state sector are higher than in the private one.
ex.zh: 在许多富裕国家，政府部门的平均收入要高于私营部门。

ex.en: Few analysts would wager that the company can double its profits again this year.
ex.zh: 很少有分析师敢断言该公司今年能再度实现利润翻番。

senses: n. 运货马车,运货车,敞篷汽车(c)

ex.en: In the nineteenth century, settlers crossed the plains in covered wagons drawn by oxen.
ex.zh: 十九世纪，拓荒者乘坐牛拉的篷车穿越平原。

senses: n. 腰，腰部；（衣服的）腰身部分

ex.en: Health guidelines suggest that a person's waist measurement should be less than half of their height.
ex.zh: 健康指南建议，人的腰围应小于身高的一半。

senses: n. [常用sing.] 等待；等待的时间

ex.en: Patients often wait more than six months for routine surgery in publicly funded hospitals.
ex.zh: 在公立医院，病人做常规手术往往要等六个多月。

ex.en: The waiter patiently explained each dish to the tourists, who were unfamiliar with the local cuisine.
ex.zh: 服务员耐心地向游客介绍每道菜，因为这些游客对当地菜肴不熟悉。

ex.en: Working as a waitress, she paid her way through university by taking evening shifts at a busy restaurant.
ex.zh: 她一边做女服务员，一边在一家繁忙的餐馆上晚班，挣够了自己上大学的费用。

senses: v. 醒来,唤醒;觉醒,醒悟
(使)认识到,(使)意识到;激起,唤起

ex.en: In zones of increased turbulence, the planes' wakes will decay more quickly and the effect will diminish.
ex.zh: 在乱流增加的区域，飞机尾部的气流会消失得更快，上升流效应也会消失。

ex.en: I usually wake at six and go for a short run before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我通常六点醒来，早餐前去短跑一会儿。

ex.en: The scandal served to wake the public to the dangers of unregulated data collection.
ex.zh: 这一丑闻使公众觉醒，认识到不受监管的数据收集的危险。

ex.en: Please wake me early tomorrow, as my train leaves before eight.
ex.zh: 请明天早点叫醒我，因为我的火车八点前发车。

senses: vt. 唤起（记忆）；使感觉到
waken.usage: 辨析:awake/awaken多用于觉醒觉悟的比喻义;waken/awaken多做及物,wake/awake多做不及物

ex.en: The noise from the construction site continued to waken residents long after midnight.
ex.zh: 建筑工地的噪音在午夜之后很久仍不断把居民吵醒。

wales.usage: adj. Welsh；人 Welshman, Welshwoman; the Welsh

ex.en: Rural communities in Wales depend heavily on tourism and sheep farming.
ex.zh: 威尔士的农村社区在很大程度上依赖旅游业和养羊业。

walk.usage: 辨析:walk步行、散步,指花时间以较慢速度徒步行进;step举步、踏步,指一步一步地踏过

ex.en: Doctors recommend a brisk thirty-minute walk each day to reduce the risk of heart disease.
ex.zh: 医生建议每天快走三十分钟，以降低患心脏病的风险。

senses: v. 筑墙围住,用墙隔开

ex.en: The old city wall was demolished in the 1960s to make way for a modern ring road.
ex.zh: 老城墙在二十世纪六十年代被拆除，为一条现代环城公路让路。

ex.en: He returned the lost wallet to its owner intact, refusing any reward for his honesty.
ex.zh: 他把捡到的钱包原封不动地还给失主，并因诚实而拒绝任何报酬。

senses: v. 漫游，闲逛；思想开小差
wander.usage: 发音类似“玩得”→她在街上“闲逛”，玩得很开心。；索引p419

ex.en: She wandered aimlessly around the streets.
ex.zh: 她在大街上漫无目的地到处游荡。

ex.en: Even when homeless individuals manage to find a shelter that will give them three meals a day and a place to sleep at night, a good number still spend the bulk of each day wandering the street.
ex.zh: 即使无家可归者设法找到了可以提供一日三餐和住宿的收容所，他们中的很大一部分人仍然终日在街头游荡。

ex.en: His mind began to wander during the long, dry lecture.
ex.zh: 在冗长乏味的讲座中，他的思绪开始开小差。

ex.en: The charity's survey found that nearly half of local families want better after-school childcare services.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构的调查发现，近一半的当地家庭希望获得更好的课后托儿服务。

ex.en: The museum's exhibition explores how the war reshaped the country's economy and social structure.
ex.zh: 博物馆的展览探讨了这场战争如何重塑了该国的经济与社会结构。

senses: n. 病房；行政区；受监护人
ward.usage: 助记:给ward(病房)送去慰问card(卡片)

ex.en: The hospital's children's ward was renovated with donations from former patients and their families.
ex.zh: 医院的儿科病房由昔日病人及其家属捐款翻修。

senses: n. 全部服装,行头(总称)
wardrobe.usage: ward(保卫)+robe(礼服)→保护礼服的地方→衣柜

ex.en: The designer advises clients to build a versatile wardrobe around a few classic, well-made pieces.
ex.zh: 这位设计师建议顾客围绕几件经典的精良单品打造一个百搭的衣橱。

senses: n. 陶器,陶器器皿;物品

ex.en: The market is famous for its delicate porcelain ware, crafted using techniques passed down through generations.
ex.zh: 这个市场以精美的瓷器著称，其制作工艺世代相传。

ex.en: The old dockside warehouse was converted into apartments when the port closed in the 1990s.
ex.zh: 二十世纪九十年代港口关闭后，码头边的旧仓库被改造成了公寓。

senses: n. 战争(状态),斗争,冲突(u)
warfare.usage: war+fare→战争(状态);辨析:war战争通称;warfare交战状态,专指“……战”,如guerrilla warfare游击战

ex.en: The documentary examines how electronic warfare has transformed modern military strategy.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了电子战如何改变了现代军事战略。

senses: a. 温暖的；保暖的；热心的
adj. 温暖的,热心的,热情的,暖色调的

ex.en: Volunteers gave warm blankets and hot meals to the refugees as temperatures fell below freezing.
ex.zh: 气温降至零度以下时，志愿者为难民送去了保暖的毛毯和热餐。

senses: n. 热情；友情；温暖；暖和

ex.en: Her warmth and patience made the new employees feel welcome from their very first day.
ex.zh: 她的热情和耐心让新员工从第一天起就感到宾至如归。

phrases.p: warn sb. not to do sth.

warn.usage: 派生warning n.警告,警示,告诫

ex.en: Economists warn that rising interest rates could push thousands of small businesses into insolvency.
ex.zh: 经济学家警告说，利率上升可能使成千上万的小企业破产。

senses: n. 授权,批准(c)；(正当)理由,根据(u)

phrases.p: obtain a warrant to do sth.

warrant.usage: 近义：justify vt. 为……辩解；证明合理；记：为了保证执法的正当性，警察在获得执行令后才行动。；n.授权令；正当理由 v.使有必要，使正当；需要， 值得；允诺，保证；war（战争）+rant（发音类似“认的”）→战争里认可的是授权令→授权令；正当理由。；索引p419

ex.en: The officers searched the house only after obtaining a warrant from a judge.
ex.zh: 警官们在获得法官签发的搜查令之后才搜查了这所房子。

ex.en: Such a minor oversight does not warrant a formal complaint.
ex.zh: 如此微小的疏忽不值得提出正式投诉。

ex.en: The severity of the drought warrants an immediate review of water policies.
ex.zh: 旱情的严重性要求立即审查用水政策。

ex.en: The washing machine is still under warranty, so the manufacturer must repair it free of charge.
ex.zh: 洗衣机仍在保修期内，所以厂家必须免费维修。

ex.en: The exhibition traces how the kingdom's warrior class shaped medieval art and politics.
ex.zh: 该展览追溯了该王国的武士阶层如何塑造了中世纪的艺术与政治。

ex.en: Many of the city's brick air-raid shelters were built during wartime and still stand today.
ex.zh: 市里许多砖砌防空洞建于战时，至今犹存。

senses: adj. (对待人或事物时)小心的,谨慎的

ex.en: Consumers have become wary of online advertisements promising unrealistic returns on small investments.
ex.zh: 消费者对那些承诺小额投资可获得不切实际回报的网络广告已变得警惕。

senses: vt.&vi. 洗澡；洗脸；洗手；流动；冲向

ex.en: Heavy rains washed away part of the mountain road, cutting off several remote villages.
ex.zh: 大雨冲垮了部分山路，切断了几个偏远村庄的对外联系。

senses: adj. 无用的,废弃的,荒芜的
waste.usage: 词组the waste of vigour精力的消耗

ex.en: The audit revealed that the department had wasted nearly two million pounds on unused office equipment.
ex.zh: 审计显示，该部门在闲置办公设备上浪费了近两百万英镑。

ex.en: Auditors described the paper-based filing system as wasteful of both time and money.
ex.zh: 审计人员称这种纸质归档系统既浪费时间又浪费金钱。

senses: v. 观看,注视;看守,监视
watch.usage: 助记:watch(观看)batch(一群)人踢球;词组on(off)watch在(不在)值班

ex.en: Researchers carefully watch the glaciers throughout the year to record changes in their rate of melting.
ex.zh: 研究人员全年仔细观测冰川，记录其融化速度的变化。

ex.en: Farmers in the region rely on irrigation channels to water their crops during the dry season.
ex.zh: 该地区的农民依靠灌溉渠在旱季给农作物浇水。

waterfall.usage: 助记:water(水)+fall(落下)→落下的水→瀑布

ex.en: The waterfall, hidden deep in the rainforest, was accessible only on foot until a trail was built last year.
ex.zh: 这个瀑布隐藏在雨林深处，直到去年修建了一条小径之前只能步行到达。

waterproof.usage: 助记:water(水)+proof(形容词后缀,防止……的)→防水的

ex.en: The jacket is waterproof, so hikers can wear it even in heavy rain.
ex.zh: 这件夹克是防水的，徒步者即使在暴雨中也能穿着。

ex.en: The phone's waterproof design protects it from damage when dropped into shallow water.
ex.zh: 手机的防水设计使其落入浅水中时不会损坏。

ex.en: Builders applied a waterproof layer to the roof before the rainy season arrived.
ex.zh: 建筑工人在雨季来临前在屋顶加了一层防水层。

senses: n. [C] 转折点，分界线，分水岭(标志着重大变化的事件或时期)；流域
watershed.usage: 联想记忆：water(水)+shed(看作shade,阴凉)→水的阴凉处→分水岭；索引p419

ex.en: World War II was the watershed event for higher education in modern Western societies.
ex.zh: 第二次世界大战是现代西方社会高等教育的分水岭。

ex.en: The invention of the Internet marked a watershed in the way people obtain information.
ex.zh: 互联网的发明标志着人们获取信息方式的分水岭。

ex.en: Historians regard the election as a watershed that reshaped the country's party system.
ex.zh: 历史学家认为这次选举是重塑该国政党体制的转折点。

ex.en: The new privacy law is a watershed for technology firms that profit from personal data.
ex.zh: 新的隐私法对靠个人数据盈利的科技公司来说是一个转折点。

ex.en: Replacing old bulbs with low-watt LED lamps can cut a household's lighting bill dramatically.
ex.zh: 用低瓦数的LED灯替换旧灯泡，可以大幅削减家庭的照明开支。

senses: n. (挥手)示意,致意;飘扬,起伏
v. (挥手)示意,致意;飘动,挥动

ex.en: A huge wave swept over the sea wall, soaking everyone standing on the promenade.
ex.zh: 一个巨浪扫过防波堤，浇湿了站在海滨步道上的每一个人。

ex.en: She waved to her friends from the platform as the train slowly pulled out.
ex.zh: 火车缓缓驶出时，她从站台上向朋友们挥手。

ex.en: An aging population is expected to bring a new wave of demand for health services.
ex.zh: 人口老龄化预计将带来新一波医疗服务需求。

wax.usage: 助记:不要给fax(传真机)wax(打蜡)

ex.en: The museum conservator applied a thin layer of wax to protect the antique wooden furniture.
ex.zh: 博物馆修复员给古董木质家具涂上一层薄蜡加以保护。

senses: n. 道路,路线;习俗,作风

ex.en: The new regulations pave the way for foreign companies to enter the domestic insurance market.
ex.zh: 新法规为外国公司进入国内保险市场铺平了道路。

ex.en: The council has promised to refurbish the public WC in the market square.
ex.zh: 市政会承诺翻新集市广场上的公共厕所。

ex.en: We tend to underestimate how quickly technology can reshape everyday habits and social interactions.
ex.zh: 我们往往低估了技术重塑日常习惯和社会交往的速度。

ex.en: The country's weak currency makes imports more expensive and fuels inflation across the economy.
ex.zh: 该国疲软的货币使进口商品更加昂贵，并在整个经济中加剧了通货膨胀。

senses: v. 减弱，削弱；（使）虚弱，衰弱

ex.en: Prolonged drought has weakened the trees, leaving them vulnerable to disease and insect attacks.
ex.zh: 持续的干旱使树木变得虚弱，使其容易受到病害和虫害的侵袭。

ex.en: The report identifies over-reliance on a single export market as the economy's chief weakness.
ex.zh: 报告指出，过度依赖单一出口市场是该经济体的主要弱点。

senses: n. 财富，财产；大量；富裕，富足
wealth.usage: 发音类似"威尔士"→威尔士多城堡让人感觉富裕；派生wealthy adj.富有的

ex.en: The new manager brings a great wealth of experience to the job.
ex.zh: 新任经理为这项工作带来了丰富的经验。

ex.en: The country's natural wealth has too often been wasted by corruption and poor management.
ex.zh: 该国的自然财富常常因腐败和管理不善而被浪费。

ex.en: A small number of families control a disproportionate share of the nation's wealth.
ex.zh: 少数家庭控制着这个国家财富中过大的一份。

ex.en: The archive offers a wealth of information about daily life in the nineteenth century.
ex.zh: 该档案馆藏有关于十九世纪日常生活的大量信息。

wealthy.usage: adj.富有的，丰富的；拓展：a wealthy nation 富国

ex.en: The deal is about to make him a very wealthy man.
ex.zh: 这笔交易将使他成为一个非常富有的人。

ex.en: The region has become wealthy through tourism and high-tech manufacturing.
ex.zh: 该地区通过旅游业和高科技制造业变得富裕起来。

ex.en: Wealthy families often send their children to private schools.
ex.zh: 富裕家庭常把子女送进私立学校。

ex.en: The treaty bans the development of any weapon capable of destroying communications satellites.
ex.zh: 该条约禁止研发任何能够摧毁通信卫星的武器。

ex.en: Employees are required to wear protective goggles whenever they enter the laboratory.
ex.zh: 员工进入实验室时必须佩戴护目镜。

ex.en: A sense of weariness has spread among nurses after years of staff shortages.
ex.zh: 在人手短缺多年之后，一种疲惫感在护士群体中蔓延。

senses: adj. 疲倦的；使人疲劳的
adj. 疲劳的，疲倦的；令人厌烦的
weary.usage: wear(穿)+y(衣服)→冬天穿的衣服又多又沉，让人很疲劳→疲劳的；（使）疲劳

ex.en: After a weary journey across the desert, the travelers finally reached the oasis.
ex.zh: 经过横穿沙漠的疲惫旅程，旅行者们终于到达了绿洲。

ex.en: Voters have grown weary of politicians who promise change but deliver little.
ex.zh: 选民们对承诺变革却收效甚微的政客感到厌倦。

ex.en: He gave a weary sigh and continued filling out the endless forms.
ex.zh: 他疲倦地叹了口气，继续填写没完没了的表格。

ex.en: The region's mild weather attracts thousands of retired people who move south each year.
ex.zh: 该地区温和的天气每年吸引成千上万南迁的退休人士。

senses: v. 编，织；(用…)编成；编造(故事等)

ex.en: Local women weave baskets from reeds and sell them to tourists at the market.
ex.zh: 当地妇女用芦苇编织篮子，在市场上卖给游客。

ex.en: The author weaves historical facts into a story that reads like a thriller.
ex.zh: 作者将史实编织进一个读起来像惊险小说的故事。

ex.en: The driver had to weave through heavy traffic to reach the hospital in time.
ex.zh: 司机不得不在拥挤的车流中穿行，以便及时赶到医院。

ex.en: The village's handloom weavers now sell their cloth directly to customers online.
ex.zh: 村里的手工织工现在直接在网上向顾客销售布料。

senses: n. 网络；错综复杂的事物
n. 网,蜘蛛网;周密的布置;圈套

ex.en: The company built a vast web of subsidiaries to conceal its true financial position from regulators.
ex.zh: 该公司构建了一个庞大的子公司网络，以向监管机构隐瞒其真实财务状况。

ex.en: The ministry's website publishes detailed figures on hospital waiting times every month.
ex.zh: 该部的网站每月公布医院候诊时间的详细数据。

ex.en: The committee usually meets on Wednesday, though extra sessions may be called.
ex.zh: 委员会通常在星期三开会，不过也可加开会议。

ex.en: The couple postponed their wedding until the following spring because of travel restrictions.
ex.zh: 由于旅行限制，这对新人将婚礼推迟到了次年春天。

senses: vt. 楔入,楔牢;挤入,插入

ex.en: Workers drove a wooden wedge into the crack to stop the rock from splitting further.
ex.zh: 工人们把一块木楔打进裂缝，以防止岩石进一步裂开。

ex.en: The committee meets every Wednesday to review applications and hear appeals from rejected candidates.
ex.zh: 委员会每周三开会，审查申请并听取被拒候选人的申诉。

ex.en: Farmers spend weeks each spring removing weeds that compete with crops for nutrients.
ex.zh: 农民每年春天都要花数周时间清除与庄稼争夺养分的杂草。

ex.en: The garden had been left untended and was overrun with tall weeds.
ex.zh: 花园无人照料，长满了高高的杂草。

ex.en: The school plans to weed out outdated courses and introduce new practical subjects.
ex.zh: 学校计划淘汰过时的课程，引入新的实用科目。

ex.en: Sales fell sharply during the first week of the promotion before recovering in the second.
ex.zh: 促销活动的第一周销售额大幅下降，第二周才有所回升。

ex.en: Ticket prices are considerably cheaper on weekdays, encouraging commuters to travel outside peak hours.
ex.zh: 工作日的票价便宜得多，鼓励通勤者错开高峰时段出行。

ex.en: City residents increasingly spend their weekend in the countryside, boosting rural tourism revenues.
ex.zh: 城市居民越来越多地在乡下度周末，推高了乡村旅游收入。

senses: adj. 每周的,一周一次的

ex.en: The magazine's weekly circulation has nearly doubled since it began publishing investigative reports.
ex.zh: 自开始刊登调查报道以来，该杂志的周发行量几乎翻了一番。

ex.en: Mourners wept openly at the memorial service for the firefighters who died in the blaze.
ex.zh: 在为大火中牺牲的消防员举行的追悼会上，哀悼者当众落泪。

senses: v. (对看法或决定)有影响,有分量
vi. (对看法或结果)有影响；重量为

phrases.m: 使(某人或某人的精神等)忧虑

ex.en: Weighing yourself regularly is a wonderful way to stay aware of any significant weight fluctuations.
ex.zh: 经常称自己的体重是使自己能随时留意到任何体重明显波动的绝佳方法。

ex.en: McClain's little ones aren't the only kids who have an opinion when it comes to housing, and in many cases youngsters' views weigh heavily on parents' real estate decisions.
ex.zh: 并不是只有麦克莱恩的孩子们在住房方面有自己的看法，而且在很多时候，孩子们的看法会极大地影响父母在房地产方面的决策。

ex.en: Before accepting the offer, she weighed the higher salary against the longer working hours.
ex.zh: 在接受这份工作之前，她权衡了更高薪水与更长的工作时间。

ex.en: The court must weigh the evidence carefully before reaching a final verdict.
ex.zh: 法庭在作出最终裁决前必须仔细权衡证据。

senses: n. 重量,分量;重(的特性)
n. 重要性,严重性或影响力(的程度)

ex.en: In musical expression, he did not feel restrained by the weight of convention.
ex.zh: 在音乐表达方面，他并未感到受制于常规。

ex.en: Doctors advised him to lose weight gradually through diet and regular exercise.
ex.zh: 医生建议他通过饮食和定期锻炼逐渐减轻体重。

ex.en: The committee's recommendation carried considerable weight with the education ministry.
ex.zh: 委员会的建议在教育部门很有分量。

ex.en: Airlines charge extra fees when luggage exceeds the permitted weight limit.
ex.zh: 行李超过允许的重量限制时，航空公司会收取额外费用。

senses: adj. 怪异的,超自然的,神秘的,不可思议的
adj. 怪异的，离奇的；奇异的
weird.usage: 他经常穿（wear）一些怪异的（weird）衣服。；索引p419

ex.en: We fear rejection, or that our innocent social advances will be misinterpreted as "weird".
ex.zh: 我们害怕被拒绝，或者害怕我们单纯的社交示好行为被误认为是“怪异的”。

ex.en: The abandoned house emitted weird sounds at night.
ex.zh: 那座废弃的房子夜里发出怪异的声音。

ex.en: It feels weird to see my hometown change almost beyond recognition.
ex.zh: 看到家乡变得几乎认不出来，让人感觉很怪异。

ex.en: The new policy received a warm welcome from employers, though unions warned that workers might lose out.
ex.zh: 新政策受到雇主的热烈欢迎，不过工会警告说工人可能会吃亏。

senses: n. 福利；社会保障金；幸福；安康
welfare.usage: 记：使老有所终，壮有所用，幼有所长，鳏寡孤独废疾者皆有所养，是谓福利(welfare)制度的理想状态。；wel(联想成well“好”)+far(远的)+e→要去好远的地方追求自己的“幸福”；welfare 福利；fare 车费。注意区别。；索引p419

ex.en: The principle of British welfare is no longer that you can insure yourself against the risk of unemployment.
ex.zh: 英国社会福利体系的原则不再是你遭遇失业风险时可以得到保障。

ex.en: The government spends a lot on social welfare.
ex.zh: 政府在社会福利上支出巨大。

ex.en: They work for the welfare of children.
ex.zh: 他们为儿童的福利而工作。

ex.en: Despite her advanced age, the professor remains well and still lectures twice a month.
ex.zh: 尽管年事已高，这位教授身体依然健康，每月仍讲课两次。

ex.en: Employers are increasingly aware that employee well-being directly affects productivity.
ex.zh: 雇主日益意识到员工的福祉直接影响生产率。

ex.en: The survey measures how income, education, and housing contribute to overall well-being.
ex.zh: 该调查衡量收入、教育和住房如何影响整体幸福感。

ex.en: Spending time in nature has been shown to improve mental well-being.
ex.zh: 花时间亲近大自然已被证明能改善心理健康。

senses: a. 受过良好教育的；知识丰富的

ex.en: Well-educated young people are leaving rural areas in search of better-paid jobs in the cities.
ex.zh: 受过良好教育的年轻人正离开农村，到城市寻找报酬更高的工作。

well-known.usage: 助记:well(好)+known(被知道的)→有名的

ex.en: The well-known economist argues that automation will eventually create more jobs than it destroys.
ex.zh: 这位著名经济学家认为，自动化最终创造的工作岗位将多于它摧毁的岗位。

ex.en: The product launch was a well-orchestrated campaign combining social media, print advertising and live events.
ex.zh: 这次产品发布是一场精心策划的宣传活动，综合运用了社交媒体、平面广告和现场活动。

ex.en: Employers increasingly favour well-rounded graduates with experience beyond a single academic discipline.
ex.zh: 雇主越来越青睐在单一学科之外还有其他阅历的全面发展型毕业生。

ex.en: Employers who invest in staff wellbeing report lower absence rates and higher productivity.
ex.zh: 在员工健康福祉上投资的雇主报告称缺勤率更低、生产率更高。

ex.en: The storm is moving west, bringing heavy rain to coastal areas later tonight.
ex.zh: 风暴正向西移动，今晚晚些时候将给沿海地区带来大雨。

ex.en: The western provinces have attracted considerable investment in renewable energy over the past decade.
ex.zh: 过去十年，西部省份在可再生能源方面吸引了相当可观的投资。

ex.en: The wet summer ruined much of the harvest, forcing farmers to import grain at considerable expense.
ex.zh: 多雨的夏天毁掉了大部分收成，迫使农民花费巨资进口粮食。

phrases.p: have a whale of a time

ex.en: Conservation groups welcomed the ban, saying it offers the whale population a genuine chance to recover.
ex.zh: 环保组织对禁令表示欢迎，称它为鲸鱼种群的真正恢复提供了机会。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

senses: pron./det. 什么；……的事物；无论什么；多么

ex.en: What surprised the researchers most was the speed at which the birds adapted to urban life.
ex.zh: 最令研究人员惊讶的是这些鸟类适应城市生活的速度。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

senses: pron./det. 无论什么；任何；任何事物
pron. (引出状语从句或名词从句)无论什么,不管怎样

ex.en: The committee has promised to consider whatever evidence the independent reviewers provide.
ex.zh: 委员会承诺会考虑独立评审人员提供的任何证据。

senses: adj. 任何的（用于加强语气）

ex.en: The investigation found no evidence whatsoever of deliberate misconduct by the bank's senior managers.
ex.zh: 调查没有发现任何证据表明该银行高级管理人员存在故意不当行为。

ex.en: Global wheat prices climbed to a record high after drought damaged harvests in several exporting countries.
ex.zh: 干旱使几个出口国的收成受损后，全球小麦价格攀升至历史新高。

senses: n. [C-常用sing.] （汽车等的）方向盘；（轮船的）舵轮
wheel.usage: 记：这辆车的车轮和方向盘都出现了故障。

ex.en: Inventors spent centuries refining the wheel, arguably the most influential device in human history.
ex.zh: 发明者们花了几个世纪不断完善车轮——它可以说是人类历史上影响最大的装置。

ex.en: The new regulations require public buildings to provide wheelchair access at the main entrance.
ex.zh: 新法规要求公共建筑在主入口提供轮椅通道。

ex.en: The strike ended when management finally agreed to raise wages by eight percent.
ex.zh: 资方最终同意加薪百分之八后，罢工结束。

senses: conj. 在任何……的时候；每当
conj. 无论何时,随时,每当

ex.en: Whenever the river floods, the farmers downstream lose a significant portion of their crops.
ex.zh: 每当河水泛滥，下游农民就会损失相当一部分庄稼。

ex.en: The report identifies regions where water shortages are likely to become severe within a decade.
ex.zh: 报告指出了可能在十年内出现严重水资源短缺的地区。

senses: conj. （用以比较或对比两个事实）尽管；鉴于
whereas.usage: 近：while conj. 而，然而；索引p419

ex.en: In all, the study concludes that whereas prosecutors should only evaluate a case based on its merits, they do seem to be influenced by a company's record in CSR.
ex.zh: 总体来说，研究得出结论称，尽管检察官应该仅仅基于它（案件）本身的情况进行评估，但他们似乎还是受到了企业社会责任(CSR)记录的影响。

ex.en: City dwellers tend to rent small flats, whereas rural families often own spacious houses.
ex.zh: 城市居民往往租住小公寓，而农村家庭通常拥有宽敞的住房。

ex.en: Sales rose sharply in Asia, whereas the European market remained flat throughout the year.
ex.zh: 亚洲销售急剧上升，而欧洲市场全年保持平稳。

ex.en: Some employees prefer fixed schedules, whereas others value the freedom to arrange their own hours.
ex.zh: 有些员工喜欢固定的日程安排，而另一些员工则看重自行安排时间的自由。

ex.en: The company introduced a system whereby employees can exchange unused holiday days for cash.
ex.zh: 公司推出了一种制度，员工可以用未休的假日兑换现金。

ex.en: They signed an agreement whereby both countries would reduce tariffs on agricultural goods.
ex.zh: 他们签署了一项两国削减农产品关税的协定。

ex.en: The scholarship created a pathway whereby talented students from poor families could attend university.
ex.zh: 该奖学金为贫困家庭的优秀学生开辟了一条上大学的途径。
